_comment: Source of truth for the video section. Run `node scripts/build-videos.mjs` after editing. Reels of https://www.instagram.com/modelayreforma/ : `instagramId` is the shortcode in the reel URL (instagram.com/reel/<instagramId>/). Videos stay hidden until "published" is true; only videos with an instagramId and uploadDate are rendered. A video with "hidden": true stays in this file but is not rendered anywhere. uploadDate comes from the reel id (Instagram encodes the publication time in the shortcode). The thumbnails are frames of each reel saved locally in images/instagram/.
